'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[United States|American]] rock band [[Linkin Park]] emerges from a seven-year hiatus with the announcement of an upcoming [[From Zero (album)|studio album]], a worldwide concert tour, and introduces [[Emily Armstrong (musician)|Emily Armstrong]] as the band's new co-vocalist. The band went on hiatus in 2017 following the death of then-lead vocalist [[Chester Bennington]]. [https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/linkin-park-new-vocalist-emily-armstrong-tour-album-from-zero-1235096109/ (''Rolling Stone'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Apalachee High School shooting]]
**The [[Georgia Bureau of Investigation]] arrests the father of Colt Gray, the perpetrator of yesterday's [[mass shooting|mass]] [[school shooting]] in [[Barrow County, Georgia|Barrow County]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], United States, on charges of [[second-degree murder]] and [[involuntary manslaughter]] for [[child access prevention law|allowing his son]] to possess a gun. *[[Domestic violence in Kenya]]
**[[Ugandans|Ugandan]] [[marathon]]er [[Rebecca Cheptegei]] dies at a hospital in [[Eldoret]], [[Kenya]], after sustaining burns from a [[gasoline]] attack by her former partner almost a month after participating in the [[Athletics at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's marathon|women's marathon]] at the [[2024 Summer Olympics]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3vx0kq2xr2o (BBC News)]
*[[Weiss special counsel investigation]]
**[[Hunter Biden]] pleads guilty to [[Tax evasion in the United States|federal tax evasion]] shortly before his trial was expected to begin in [[California]], United States. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/joe-biden/hunter-biden-intends-plead-guilty-federal-tax-charges-rcna169621 (NBC News)]
*[[2024 Munich shooting]]
**An [[Austrians|Austrian]] man is killed in a shootout with [[Law enforcement in Germany|police]] in [[Munich]], [[Germany]], near the [[Munich Documentation Centre for the History of National Socialism]] and the [[Consulate-General of Israel, Munich|Israeli Consulate]]. A [[terrorist]] motive is suspected. [https://time.com/7018025/police-shooting-nazi-museum-israel-consulate-munich/ (''TIME'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Niuean constitutional referendum]]
**Voters in [[Niue]] approve a bill to change the title of the [[Premier of Niue]] to [[Prime Minister of Niue|prime minister]], effective immediately, while rejecting a proposal to increase the term of the [[Niue Assembly]] from three to four years. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/527122/niueans-reject-proposals-to-increase-cabinet-ministers-to-6-and-parliamentary-term-to-4yrs (Radio New Zealand)]
*[[Reform of the House of Lords]]
**[[House of Lords (Hereditary Peers) Bill]]
***In the United Kingdom, the ruling [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] drafts a bill that would remove the right of all [[hereditary peer]]s to sit in the [[House of Lords]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgl2j90ydzgo (BBC News)]
*[[Michel Barnier]] is appointed [[Prime Minister of France]], succeeding caretaker [[Gabriel Attal]], who announced his resignation in the aftermath of the [[2024 French legislative election|legislative elections]] in July. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/09/05/michel-barnier-france-prime-minister-macron/ (''The Washington Post'')]
